title: Quaint Rich Dutch Beef Stew
description: A rich and cozy Dutch dish featuring tender beef, chilli, and cure, made paleo-friendly with wholesome ingredients. This stew is perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the diced chilli peppers and cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the beef cubes and cook until they are browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the beef broth, tomato paste, sea salt, black pepper, and cure, stirring to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2.5 hours.
Remove the stew from the heat and let it cool slightly before serving.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
